item.title: Good morning, Bluesky. My daughter’s first experience with a…
item.author: Laura Lippman (@lauralippman.bsky.social)
item.description:
Good morning, Bluesky.
My daughter’s first experience with a (wonderfully) stereotypical Dublin cab driver involved a man named Larry Russell, who turned off his meter and drove us deep into Phoenix Park, quizzing joggers until we found a herd of deer.
We saw A LOT of deer.
